definitions.sampling_units: Six dependent acquired states from two permutations of one floorplan; neither66candidatebranches nor checkpoints are independent scenes.
definitions.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of state-level means/fractions; each completed state equalweight. A partial summary is not a stage-selection result.
definitions.template_ranking: Within each state, rank template-only predicted gain vs actual object gross/net newly reconstructed source area; Spearman undefined if constant.
definitions.full_score: Original common_total_proxy + template gain. Selected candidate actualglobal/object area, coverage and cost reported separately, not conflated into an invented measured utility.
definitions.weights: Weighted alternative-template quadrature integrals are not unique true surface area.
definitions.positive_result: G/S divergence alone is not evidence of benefit; all states/variants and actual deficits retained.
definitions.selection_gap: Descriptive gap from best observed object area among declared candidates; no evaluator-based choice was executed by the policy.
definitions.branch_reuse: Exactly the original66 fixed-candidate branch meshes and execution receipts, not new outcomes. New variants only change measured-prefix predictions and score-derived choices.
definitions.applicability: Absolute free-evidence discount is a heuristic model-consistency mass, not a calibrated probability. Lower absolute predicted/supported mass may be intentional; examine realised selections and predicted support jointly.
definitions.comparison: Every prior v1 variant and new pooling factorial is retained on matched completed states; never compare a partial subset against all6priorstates.
